The venue was abuzz with talk of the 
participating Umamusume. King Halo, the 
amusing celebrity who had recently been 
making waves in the media, was no 
exception and drew plenty of attention.

Meanwhile, in the Yasuda Kinen waiting 
room, King Halo boldly declared that her 
opponents made no difference to her.

"I don't need anyone standing in my way. 
I'll kick every last one of them aside 
with these legs!" Full of high spirits, 
she took on the race.
